name: everwrite
topic: the signs of AI-generated prose and how to write without them: pattern catalogues, humanizer skills, checkers, what current models still overuse

volatile_claims.claim: Claude uses em dashes more than professional writers, while newer GPT models suppress them (Economist, July 2026, via Wikipedia)
blader/humanizer (3.0.0) is the most-starred prose humanizer skill; none of the top three ships a deterministic checker
Mid-2025-on stock words per Wikipedia: emphasizing, enhance, highlighting, showcasing, plus canned notability wording
Claude text is watermarked (SynthID-Text style, no added characters) for models from 2026-08-02; older models by December 2026; detection is a private preview
ChatGPT text carries no watermark; OpenAI says it aims to add text marking
No public checker exists for deployed text watermarks (SynthID Detector is waitlist-only)

events.label: EU AI Act Art. 50(2) grace period ends; Anthropic's retrofit target for older models; OpenAI text marking likely
